subject: business-studies
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: If selling price is 10 pounds and variable cost per unit is 6 pounds, the contribution per unit is:
questions.explain: Contribution per unit = selling price (10) - variable cost per unit (6) = 4 pounds.

questions.q: Why is good customer service important to a business?
options: It always lowers costs to zero
It can increase customer loyalty and repeat business
It removes the need to sell products
questions.explain: Good customer service encourages loyalty and repeat purchases, helping sales and reputation.

questions.q: Net profit margin is calculated as:
questions.explain: Net profit margin = (net profit divided by revenue) x 100, expressed as a percentage.

questions.q: Job production is best described as:
options: Producing one-off, customised products to a specific order
Making identical products on a continuous line
Making products in groups or sets
questions.explain: Job production makes single, often customised items, such as a tailored suit or a bridge.

options: A fall in average cost per unit as output increases
A rise in average cost per unit as output increases
questions.explain: Economies of scale mean the average cost per unit falls as a business produces on a larger scale.

questions.q: A cash-flow forecast is used to:
options: Predict future cash coming in and going out
questions.explain: A cash-flow forecast predicts the timing of cash inflows and outflows to spot shortages early.

options: Making groups of similar products together before switching to another batch
questions.explain: Batch production makes a quantity of one product, then switches to make a batch of another, e.g. bread.

questions.q: A reliable supply chain is important because it:
options: Removes the need for stock control
Increases the chance of running out of stock
Ensures materials and products are available when needed
questions.explain: An efficient supply chain ensures the right materials and goods are available at the right time.

questions.q: Crowdfunding as a source of finance means:
options: Raising small amounts of money from a large number of people, often online
Selling shares on the stock exchange
questions.explain: Crowdfunding raises finance from many people contributing small amounts, usually via an online platform.

questions.q: Which of these is a fixed cost?
questions.explain: Rent does not change with output, so it is a fixed cost.

questions.q: Why can a profitable business still run out of cash?
options: Profit is always paid in cash immediately
Profit and cash are the same thing
Customers may pay later while the business must pay its own bills now
questions.explain: Profit and cash differ in timing; a firm can be profitable yet short of cash if money comes in slowly.

options: Adding fixed costs and variable costs
questions.explain: Total costs = fixed costs + variable costs.
